Nov 4, 2026
90
MonsterVine
Psycho-Sleuth is an exciting and entertaining death game visual novel, with plenty of twists and turns along the way. Cognitive distortions mean even your own perception can hide the truth, which deepens the mystery of each case. Meanwhile, the characters are the heart and soul of the game as you get to know them through lengthy visual novel scenes. Altogether, Psycho-Sleuth is an easy recommendation if you enjoy death game stories and murder mysteries.
PC FULL REVIEW
Nov 3, 2026
80
Final Weapon
Psycho-Sleuth's death game premise is hardly a new idea, but it manages to carve its own path and justify its existence. It's a brutally graphic story about empathy, and as such, it fittingly cares about each every one of its characters.
PC FULL REVIEW
Nov 2, 2026
80
GAMES.CH
Psycho-Sleuth creates a compelling world based on the psychological disorders of its characters, who compete against each other to become a new god. Between murders, logic puzzles and debates, the characters try to solve the mystery of the Logic-Church, who is holding the death game they are a part of. With Psycho-Sleuth, detective death games receive a fresh angle that is sure to excite fans of the genre.
PC FULL REVIEW
Nov 3, 2026
75
Oyungezer
Psycho-Sleuth tells a genuinely compelling story with genuinely compelling characters. I only wish its gameplay were as engaging as its story and characters.
